new_news.headline: Top waste companies spent nearly $700M on M&A in Q1 2026
new_news.summary: Major publicly traded solid waste and recycling companies spent nearly $700 million on M&A in Q1 2026. WM completed its acquisition of Waste Resources in California in May; Republic Services closed several deals including landfill and hauler acquisitions; GFL Environmental announced purchases including Frontier Waste Solutions.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Anticipates Q2 Core Ingredients EBITDA of $260M-$275M as RVO Shifts Renewables Margins
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 turning point with combined adjusted EBITDA of $406.8M, including $151.2M from Diamond Green Diesel. The March RVO announcement proved "extremely constructive" for the company and DGD, with renewables margins showing significant improvement.

new_news.headline: WRM Acquires a Majority of Darling Ingredients' Trap Grease Business
new_news.summary: Waste Resource Management, LLC (WRM) has entered a definitive agreement to acquire the majority of Darling Ingredients' trap grease collection and processing assets. The transaction expands WRM's footprint in 13 U.S. metro markets and enhances service capabilities while driving vertical integration across the platform.

new_news.headline: US Imports More Used Cooking Oil From China for Biofuels
new_news.summary: Two cargoes carrying a combined 339,000 barrels of used cooking oil from China arrived in the U.S. recently, with significant volumes delivered to Port Arthur, Texas (Diamond Green Diesel facility). US biofuel-blending requirements and high energy costs make UCO imports increasingly attractive.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients 2026 Investor Day: Q1 Adjusted EBITDA of $406.8M, Cash Generation Targets of $4–6B Through 2030
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients' 2026 Investor Day outlines Q1 2026 EBITDA of $406.8M, leverage of 1.82x, and scenarios targeting $4–6B in cash generation through 2030 for debt reduction and growth. Management positions Diamond Green Diesel as a core earnings engine at roughly 1.2B gallons of renewable diesel capacity, including sustainable aviation fuel.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 2026: EPS Beat, Revenue Miss; Raises Full-Year EBITDA and Free Cash Flow Guidance
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors' Q1 2026 revenue reached $1.46B with net income of $63.2M and EPS of $1.19, as Adjusted EBITDA rose 6% and the company raised full-year 2026 EBITDA and free cash flow guidance. Environmental Services segment adjusted EBITDA margin achieved the 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year improvement, with Technical Services revenue up 5%, and Safety-Kleen Environmental Services revenue up 7%.

new_news.headline: How used cooking oil is making the tyre industry greener
new_news.summary: Tyre manufacturers like Continental are increasingly using waste cooking oil to produce synthetic rubber and additives, supporting circular economy principles and reducing environmental impact.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q1 2026 Earnings: Record-Setting 29.1% EBITDA Margin, 8.5% Revenue Growth, Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental reported industry leading top line growth of 8.5% before considering foreign exchange headwinds, including 7.0% from core pricing and 180 basis points of Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion. Since the start of the year, GFL completed eight acquisitions, generating between $425.0 million to $450.0 million in annualized revenue.
